RCSP-41.description: End-to-end Log Waste coverage: navigation, create modal, ITEM/RECIPE save, validation, lock, apply to stock, multi-row, edge values, and permissions.

prerequisites: User has valid credentials with Wastage / Log Waste access
A unit is available (e.g., WB Unit 1034)

labels.pageDescription: Grouped waste submissions by date and shift

unauthorizedUser.note: Set unauthorized Wastage credentials here to enable TC_RCSP-41_010 unauthorized path

testCases.testName: Verify whether clicking Log Waste opens the Waste Logs page with title, subtitle, + LOG WASTE button, and grid columns
testCases.description: Verify Wastage → Log Waste navigation and Waste Logs page chrome.
testCases.preCondition: 1. QA Backoffice is accessible. 2. User has Log Waste access. 3. Unit available (WB Unit 1034).

testSteps.description: Launch QA Backoffice and log in.
Select unit WB Unit 1034.
Expand Wastage and click Log Waste.
Verify title, subtitle, + LOG WASTE, and grid columns.

testCases.expectedResult: User lands on Waste Logs with expected title, subtitle, CTA, and columns.

testData.expectedPageDescription: Grouped waste submissions by date and shift

testCases.testName: Verify whether + LOG WASTE modal Shift options AM/Mid-Shift/PM work, CANCEL closes without create, CREATE WASTE LOG opens detail page
testCases.description: Verify Log Waste create modal Shift options and CANCEL vs CREATE.
testCases.preCondition: User is on Wastage → Log Waste (Waste Logs page).

testSteps.description: Click + LOG WASTE and verify modal + Shift options.
Click CANCEL and confirm no new log.
Create waste log with Shift AM.

testCases.rawTestData: Shift options: AM / Mid-Shift / PM. Preferred: AM.
testCases.expectedResult: Modal lists AM/Mid-Shift/PM; CANCEL creates nothing; CREATE opens detail page.

testCases.testName: Verify whether Type ITEM mandatory fields save successfully and log remains editable
testCases.description: Verify ITEM waste line SAVE with all mandatory fields.
testCases.preCondition: User is on a newly created waste log detail page.

testSteps.description: Set Type ITEM and fill Item, Reason, UOM, Quantity, Notes.
Click SAVE and confirm values retained.

testCases.rawTestData: Type ITEM; Item LARGE BUNS; Reason Over-Prep Production; Qty 1
testCases.expectedResult: SAVE succeeds; line retained; LOCK available.

testCases.testName: Verify whether Type RECIPE mandatory fields save successfully
testCases.description: Verify RECIPE waste line SAVE with all mandatory fields.
testCases.preCondition: User is on an editable waste log detail page.

testSteps.description: Set Type RECIPE and fill Recipe, Reason, UOM, Quantity, Notes.
Click SAVE and confirm recipe line retained.

testCases.rawTestData: Type RECIPE; valid recipe; Quality Issue reason
testCases.expectedResult: RECIPE SAVE succeeds and line is retained.

testCases.testName: Verify whether SAVE without mandatory fields is blocked with clear validation
testCases.preCondition: User is on an editable waste log detail page with blank/partial row.

testSteps.description: Attempt SAVE with missing Item/Reason/UOM/Quantity/Notes combinations.
Confirm validation messages and no persist.

testCases.expectedResult: Incomplete SAVE is blocked with clear validation; page stays editable.

testCases.testName: Verify whether LOCK after successful SAVE makes lines non-editable and enables APPLY TO STOCK
testCases.description: Verify LOCK after SAVE and APPLY readiness.
testCases.preCondition: At least one valid waste line has been saved; LOCK is enabled.

testSteps.description: Click LOCK.
Confirm fields not editable and APPLY TO STOCK available.

testCases.rawTestData: Previously saved valid ITEM or RECIPE waste line
testCases.expectedResult: LOCK succeeds; lines not editable; APPLY TO STOCK available.

testCases.testName: Verify whether APPLY TO STOCK with OK confirmation posts waste and prevents duplicate apply
testCases.description: Verify APPLY TO STOCK → OK and duplicate-apply prevention.
testCases.preCondition: Waste log locked successfully; APPLY TO STOCK available.

testSteps.description: Click APPLY TO STOCK and confirm OK.
Confirm success and duplicate apply blocked.

testCases.rawTestData: Locked waste log; Unit WB Unit 1034
testCases.expectedResult: Confirmation shown; apply succeeds; duplicate apply prevented.

testCases.testName: Verify whether + ADD ROW supports multiple ITEM/RECIPE lines then SAVE → LOCK → APPLY
testCases.description: Verify multi-row add/delete then SAVE → LOCK → APPLY.
testCases.preCondition: User is on an editable waste log detail page.

testSteps.description: Add ITEM row and RECIPE row via + ADD ROW.
SAVE, LOCK, APPLY TO STOCK.

testCases.rawTestData: Row1 ITEM LARGE BUNS; Row2 RECIPE CHEESEBURGER
testCases.expectedResult: Multiple rows saved; LOCK/APPLY succeed for multi-line log.

testCases.testName: Verify whether Reason list is complete and Quantity/Notes edge values are handled without breaking SAVE
testCases.description: Verify Reason list + Quantity/Notes boundary values.
testCases.preCondition: User is on an editable waste log detail page with a valid item available.

testSteps.description: Open Reason dropdown and confirm all approved reasons.
Try decimal and large Quantity; special Notes; observe SAVE behavior.

testCases.rawTestData: Qty 0.5; 99999; special notes; full reason list
testCases.expectedResult: All reasons listed; valid edges save; invalid edges blocked clearly; UI stable.

testCases.testName: Verify whether unauthorized users cannot access Log Waste while authorized users complete full happy path
testCases.description: Permission denial + full happy path SAVE → LOCK → APPLY.
testCases.preCondition: Unauthorized and authorized users exist; valid item/reason data available.

testSteps.description: Unauthorized user cannot access Log Waste.
Authorized user completes create → fill → SAVE → LOCK → APPLY → OK.

testCases.rawTestData: Unauthorized credentials; authorized happy path ITEM AM
testCases.expectedResult: Unauthorized blocked; authorized completes end-to-end apply to stock.
